rationale: canvas-kernel: TextFontContext installs a dynamic font manager on Apple so SkParagraph resolves the system UI font at its exact requested weight instead of a nearest-face fallback. Additive, Apple-only, gated on the platform font database being usable; no public API, ABI, or authority boundary moves. Pulp-only because it serves Pulp's Chromium-parity text path for imported designs.
